method_note: Information only; not financial or investment advice. Past rewards do not predict future rewards. Realised, not modelled: built from the measured rewards in epoch-rewards. The typical node figures use the median single-node owner reward per epoch. Rates are simple annualised (no compounding) and only as good as the window's coverage: check complete and days_covered. Windows are whole UTC days ending with the most recent recorded day, which may be only partly over (so 1d is often incomplete). Owner APR is the owner's measured rewards over the epochs they had eligible nodes, annualised, divided by their own stake per masternode x the average number of masternodes they had (votes from others are excluded, as voters receive 0 %).
